implementation.summary: Execute eligible public one-shot legacy-high GF8 decodes through a scratch-resident, non-owning translated-low pattern view, avoiding transient heap plan construction while preserving the reusable-plan path.

eligibility.backend: explicit AVX2, or AUTO only when it resolves to the pure AVX2 backend
eligibility.missing_original_count: greater than the existing direct-repair threshold

execution: Build permanent, dynamic, unavailable, and deterministic virtual erasure metadata in caller scratch only after complete validation.
Use translated-low Algorithm 4 with existing mature GF8 AVX2 kernels, null pruned schedules, aligned-prefix locator reveal, and padded-tail staging/gather.
Fail closed to the existing owning plan path when layout, metadata capacity, work rows, backend, or pattern eligibility is unsuitable.
safety: All pointer arrays, presence arrays, scratch ranges, shard ranges, input/output overlap, and output/output overlap are validated before scratch metadata or output bytes are written.
The view owns no memory and is never exposed as a leo2_decode_plan; reusable immutable plans are unchanged.
Public eligible one-shot execution performs zero heap allocations; allocation-counting tests also cover failure and reusable-plan execution.
No-loss, direct repair, unsupported backend, byte 257, forced-hook mode, and other ineligible cases retain their prior dispatch.

frozen_artifacts.candidate_avx2_identity: AVX2 translation unit compiled with -mavx2 -mno-avx512f; zero EVEX-prefixed instructions found
frozen_artifacts.main_native_context_identity: GCC 13.3 -march=native on this Zen 5 host; AVX-512 instructions are present and this is reported separately from the controlled pure-AVX2 comparison

measurement_protocol.orientation: control or Leopard1 main decode-including-setup time divided by candidate public one-shot decode-including-setup time
measurement_protocol.affinity: The entire measurement chain was pinned to CPU 8; /proc/self/status Cpus_allowed_list was recorded.
measurement_protocol.isolation: CPU 24 sibling jiffies were audited before and after every outer round; contaminated rounds were rejected and retried.
measurement_protocol.binary_provenance: Every frozen executable was SHA-256 checked before and after each run.
measurement_protocol.correctness: Original-data, transmitted-parity, and recovered-original digests matched in every accepted comparison.

same_source_full_present.description: Base control versus candidate, all parity shards available, public one-shot decode.

same_source_mixed_availability.description: Base control versus candidate with missing originals plus missing recovery shards.

leopard1_main_controlled_pure_avx2.description: Exact Leopard main codec at commit 6e5725e versus candidate public one-shot Leopard2, with both hot arithmetic paths constrained to pure AVX2 and maximum original loss.

leopard1_main_native_context.description: Context-only comparison against Leopard main compiled with -march=native on this host; the main binary contains AVX-512, while candidate Leopard2 remains in its explicit pure-AVX2 backend.

clang18_asan_ubsan_lsan.options: ASAN detect_leaks/halt/strict_string_checks; UBSAN halt with stack traces

focused_cases: Power-of-two translated parent boundaries P=16 and P=32, immediately below and above the boundary, maximum loss, mixed availability, and byte tails 1,63,64,65,255,256.
Explicit AVX2 and AUTO when AUTO resolves to AVX2.
Public one-shot zero-allocation recovery and reusable-plan zero-allocation execution.
Byte 257 and forced test-hook mode heap fallback.

Failure atomicity for undersized or misaligned scratch, pointer/presence mismatch, null output, every input/output or output/output alias class, late invalid presence, insufficient data, scratch/metadata overlap, and overflowing address ranges.

promotion.basis: Correctness and failure-atomicity gates pass; all measured target cells are non-regressive; controlled pure-AVX2 Leopard1 comparisons improve 1.16x to 2.33x at the median; same-source full-availability comparisons improve 1.08x to 1.34x at the median.
limits: The optimized route is deliberately narrow: legacy-high GF8, native layout, AVX2, N<=256, bytes<=256, R>1, and losses above direct-repair crossover.

Mixed-availability B=256 cells at K=95 and K=128 remain positive but can improve by less than the general 5 percent promotion guideline; deterministic eligibility avoids all observed regressions and future tuning may narrow these cells further.
This change removes transient owning-plan setup; it does not reduce reusable-plan execution cost or alter the wire profile.
